## Purpose
A single Next.js-style API route that proxies a Goodreads RSS feed. It takes `shelf` and `userId` query parameters, fetches `https://www.goodreads.com/review/list_rss/{userId}?shelf={shelf}` server-side with a browser User-Agent, and returns the raw XML.

## Key concepts
- `handler` in `goodreads.ts`: returns 400 if `shelf` or `userId` is missing, 500 on fetch failure, otherwise 200 with `Content-Type: application/xml`.
- Intended as a CORS-avoiding proxy for the Goodreads feed that [[src-components-books-card]] displays.

## Gotchas
- `package.json` has no `next` dependency and the app builds with Vite (and deploys as static GitHub Pages output), so this route cannot run in the deployed site.
- No file in src references `/api/goodreads`; [[src-components-books-card]] calls the allorigins.win proxy directly instead, so this route looks unused.
